articles.summary: Received Midnight’s Market Survey Special Airworthiness Certificate from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) unlocking operations in Los Angeles in coming weeks as Archer prepares for carrying passengers as part of Department of Transportation’s eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) and LA28 Games. Acquisition of Boeing’s Wisk, Insitu, and SkyGrid businesses nearing close, set to accelerate Archer’s evolution into becoming a diversified aerospace and defense platform with significant revenue generating operations 1 . Began testing the turboshaft engine for Archer’s Halo/Thunder hybrid, autonomous VTOL platform and remain on-track to begin full-scale flight testing next year with Anduril. Archer partners with Formula 1 on a multi-year relationship to explore the future integration of eVTOL air taxi services at Grand Prix events.
